scenarios.setting: You run into someone whose name you have forgotten.

replies.line: I remember meeting you; remind me of your name.
replies.why: It separates recognizing the person from recalling their name without pretending.
replies.delivery: Smile gently, ask once, then use their name naturally after they answer.

followUp.line: You're right, and I'm sorry; I'd rather ask than pretend I remember.
